title: ProgressMessage
description: AI Service → Backend progress update, POSTed to /internal/v1/progress whenever an important stage changes. §38

selection_reason.description: Present for Planner progress messages announcing an agent selection or skip. §20, §35

data_ref.description: Pointer to the stored result, e.g. 'agent_results/ocean'. Preferred over inlining large payloads.

data.description: Inline data, only for small payloads where a data_ref round-trip isn't worth it.
